name: DRIVEAWAY
description: Full-stack marketplace with customer, dealer, and admin roles, secure Razorpay payments, automated booking lifecycle jobs, Redis caching, MongoDB data modeling, Dockerized services, and CI/CD deployment.
highlights: Three-role RBAC for customers, dealers, and admins
Server-side payment order creation and signature verification
Automated booking expiry, activation, and completion schedules

preview.title: Cars, bookings, payments, and dashboards in one deployed flow

name: SentinelFace
description: Modular real-time face recognition application with a responsive PySide6 GUI, ONNX Runtime inference, SCRFD detection, ArcFace embeddings, FairFace age and gender classification, tracking, and defensive health monitoring.
highlights: ML workloads run off the UI thread for real-time responsiveness
GPU inference with automatic CPU fallback
Tracking, re-identification, telemetry, and camera resilience

preview.title: Detection, embeddings, demographics, and health signals

name: Panoptic Segmentation
description: Multimodal AI vision platform combining YOLOv8 segmentation, object tracking, scene memory, Ollama-backed reasoning, live camera streams, analytics, heatmaps, and a React TypeScript dashboard.
highlights: Live MJPEG camera segmentation with WebSocket event updates
Scene-memory-first query routing with LLM fallback
Analytics, object counts, spatial heatmaps, and video Q&A

preview.title: Live feed, scene memory, chat, and analytics dashboard

name: Awetales Project
tagline: Target speaker identification and multispeaker ASR
description: Modular neural audio pipeline for target speaker extraction, diarization, ASR, denoising, speech restoration, overlap detection, real-time WebSocket streaming, and structured JSON transcription output.
highlights: Target speaker extraction using reference audio
Multiple ASR backends with diarized timestamps and confidence scores
Offline batch mode plus low-latency streaming mode

preview.title: Denoise, separate, identify, transcribe, and stream
